description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Vavuniya District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
reasoning: This gazette content is a notification about the postponement of local authority elections, specifically addressing the change of election date from March 9, 2023 to April 25, 2023 for several local government bodies in the Vavuniya Administrative District. It falls under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with electoral processes, election scheduling changes, and is issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
